# Supplier Incident Management

## Purpose

Coordinate response when a supplier incident may affect company operations, information, users, or obligations.

## Requirements

Material supplier incidents SHOULD identify relationship owner, affected services/data, current supplier facts, contractual notification rights, containment options under company control, continuity impact, communication needs, and evidence requests.

Supplier statements are evidence inputs, not substitutes for independent impact assessment.

## Coordination

Use the company incident process when impact crosses the incident threshold. Privacy, legal, security, resilience, and communications review may be required.

## Follow-up

Assess supplier remediation, contract performance, monitoring changes, concentration risk, and whether replacement or reduced dependency is warranted.

See [Supplier Incident SOP](../sop/SUPPLIER_INCIDENT_SOP.md).
